title: S11 validation report
description: docs/validation.md's degradation ladder. ladder_rung/verdict are computed by oah/validate/verdict.py's compute_ladder_verdict, the one place this decision is made -- see its own module docstring for the exact rule. Short version: ladder_rung is 'R2'/verdict 'validated' when --dynamic ran, the regression gate passed, there is at least one DTO S10 actually applied, and every one of those DTOs' relevant checks came back positive (event_assertions 'observed' for ordinary DTOs, propagation_checks 'present' for propagate_context DTOs) -- matching the ladder table's own definition of R2 as BOTH checks together, not either alone. On top of that, ladder_rung is 'R1' (a strict superset of R2, still verdict 'validated') when --live also ran and succeeded, live_execution.tcr.tcr is exactly 1.0 (every captured trace complete), and live_execution.overhead_vs_budget.within_budget is true. Anything short of R2's own requirements stays 'R4' (static-only ceiling, or --dynamic ran but didn't fully earn R2), 'needs_review' -- except a real regression_gate failure, which is 'validation_failed' regardless of everything else. regression_gate wires E6 R2's sandbox mechanism into the deterministic layer's own step 1 ('instrumentation must not break the product') independent of ladder_rung. R3 and the agentic audit panel aren't attempted at all -- ladder_rung and verdict grow further when they land, not silently redefined.

ladder_rung.description: R4: static-only ceiling, or --dynamic/--live ran but the run didn't earn R2/R1 (see compute_ladder_verdict). R2: --dynamic ran, the regression gate passed, and every applicable DTO's event-emission (or propagation, for propagate_context DTOs) check came back positive -- the ladder table's actual definition of R2, both halves together. R1: everything R2 needs, PLUS --live succeeded with a real TCR of exactly 1.0 and a real --baseline overhead comparison that's within budget -- R1's own two defining checks, both real.

verdict.description: needs_review: R4's own ceiling, or --dynamic/--live ran but didn't earn R2/R1. validation_failed: regression_gate actually ran the target's test suite in the sandbox and it failed after instrumentation -- forces this verdict regardless of everything else. validated: paired with ladder_rung 'R2' or 'R1' -- see compute_ladder_verdict for the exact promotion rule. Never claimed for R3, which isn't built.

regression_gate.description: docs/validation.md's deterministic layer step 1 ('instrumentation must not break the product'), wired via E6 R2's sandbox mechanism (oah/validate/sandbox.py, pytest_runner.py) -- independent of ladder_rung, not itself a claim of any ladder rung. Only meaningful when --dynamic was passed to `oah validate`; otherwise 'not_attempted'.

status.description: not_attempted: --dynamic not passed. skipped: --dynamic passed but inconclusive (Docker unavailable, no test suite found, or the install ladder failed) -- never evidence the target is broken. passed: the target's real test suite ran and passed in the sandbox. failed: it ran and something failed -- the only status that forces verdict=validation_failed.

event_assertions.description: One entry per DTO in the input implementation_dto.json, in the same order -- real R2's own defining check, first half (oah/validate/event_assertion.py): does a single real OTel span, captured from the same --dynamic sandboxed run as regression_gate, actually have every one of this DTO's expected_events[].required_attributes together? Empty array is valid (no DTOs given).

status.description: not_attempted: --dynamic not passed. skipped: --dynamic passed but the sandboxed run never actually reached pytest (Docker unavailable, no test suite found, or the install ladder failed) -- distinct from not_observed, which means the run DID happen and still found nothing. observed: a single captured span had every required attribute together. not_observed: no single span did -- reason names which attributes were never found together.

provenance.description: docs/decisions/025 (S11 signal provenance): present only when status is 'observed' -- whose instrumentation actually produced the matching span(s), classified from each span's own instrumentation_scope name. 'unknown' when the capture mechanism didn't carry that field at all -- --dynamic's own ConsoleSpanExporter-based capture (oah/validate/pytest_runner.py) never does, a real, structural limit of that mechanism, not a guess. Absent (not an empty array) for every status other than 'observed'.

propagation_checks.description: One entry per DTO in the input implementation_dto.json, in the same order -- real R2's own defining check, second half (oah/validate/propagation_checker.py): for propagate_context DTOs only, a static (no --dynamic needed) check of trace-ID propagation across the async/queue boundary, classified heuristically from change.description's free text. Empty array is valid (no DTOs given).

status.description: not_applicable: change.type isn't propagate_context -- this checker has nothing to say about it. skipped: propagate_context, but not applied by S10, its file/anchor is missing, or change.description's boundary shape couldn't be classified -- never guessed. present: the classified boundary's expected propagation code was found (or, for an asyncio.create_task boundary, none is required in the first place). absent: classified, but the expected evidence was not found -- reason names what was expected.

live_execution.description: E6 R1's execution mechanism (oah/validate/live_sandbox.py) wired via `oah validate --live`: a real running target service alongside a real local OTel collector, real driven traffic. null when --live wasn't passed at all. When this succeeds with tcr.tcr == 1.0 and (with --baseline) overhead_vs_budget.within_budget == true, ladder_rung can reach 'R1' -- see oah/validate/verdict.py's compute_ladder_verdict for the exact rule.

status.description: Mirrors live_sandbox.run_live_sandbox's own status vocabulary directly. Only 'ok' has real requests/latency/spans data attached.

requests.description: One entry per item in --requests, in order -- real per-request outcome from the live run.

fail_open.description: null unless a fail-open check was requested; see live_sandbox.run_live_sandbox's own kill_collector_after_request (not yet exposed via the CLI this phase).

event_assertions.description: One entry per DTO in the input implementation_dto.json, in the same order -- reuses oah/validate/event_assertion.py's check_dto_dynamic directly against spans captured by the live run. Empty when live_execution.status != 'ok' (nothing real to assert against) or when no DTOs were given.

provenance.description: docs/decisions/025: present only when status is 'observed'. Unlike --dynamic's own event_assertions, --live's OTLP-JSON capture (oah/validate/live_sandbox.py) DOES carry each span's real instrumentation_scope name, so this is meaningfully populated here, not just 'unknown' by construction.

unknown_attributes.description: oah/validate/live_diff.py's check_unknown_attributes: do captured spans carry any attribute name event_schema.json doesn't declare?

status.description: not_attempted: --event-schema wasn't given. clean: every captured attribute name is declared. unknown_attributes_found: at least one wasn't -- see 'unknown'.

tcr.description: oah/validate/tcr.py's compute_tcr -- R1's own primary metric per docs/architecture.md: share of captured traces (spans grouped by trace_id) reconstructable end-to-end with no missing spans (no span's parent_span_id points at a span_id that was never captured, within that same trace).
traces_complete / traces_total. null when traces_total is 0 -- never a fabricated 0.0 or 1.0 for 'nothing captured'.

overhead_vs_budget.description: oah/validate/overhead.py's compute_overhead_vs_budget: real latency-overhead-vs-declared-budget, R1's other defining check alongside tcr. Only meaningful when --baseline was passed (with --live); otherwise 'not_attempted'.

status.description: not_attempted: --baseline not passed. skipped: --baseline passed but the baseline or instrumented run didn't succeed -- never a fabricated comparison against a run that didn't happen. ok: both runs succeeded, overhead is real.

overhead_p50_ms.description: instrumented latency minus baseline latency -- the raw signed delta, reported even if negative (measurement noise), never clamped to zero.

budget_ms.description: Sum of estimated_overhead_ms across DTOs S10 actually applied. null when budget_complete is false -- never a silent 0 for a DTO missing its own estimate.

budget_complete.description: false when any applied DTO's estimated_overhead_ms is null -- the budget can't be fairly compared against.

within_budget.description: overhead_p95_ms <= budget_ms. null unless status is 'ok' and budget_complete is true.

reason.description: Explains a non-'ok' status; null for 'ok'.

results.description: One entry per DTO in the input implementation_dto.json, in the same order. Empty array is valid (no DTOs given).

status.description: present: every expected_events[].required_attributes string was found in change.file at or after change.anchor -- a code-level presence claim only, not a runtime guarantee. absent: at least one was missing (missing_attributes names which). skipped: this DTO was never applied by S10 (status != 'applied' in the instrument report, or missing from it entirely) -- nothing to check, never silently omitted from results.

missing_attributes.description: Present only when status is 'absent'; null otherwise.

reason.description: Required context for 'skipped' (why this DTO has no applied code to check); null otherwise.
